title: Decimal to Octal and Hexadecimal

content.problemStatement: Write a program to convert Decimal to Octal and Hexadecimal.

solution.approach: Read two decimal integers; convert the first to octal and the second to uppercase hexadecimal.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Print octal using %o and uppercase hexadecimal using %X.

hints: Use '%o' format specifier for octal representation.
Separate the two representations with a space.
learningObjectives: Control letter case in hexadecimal output.
